ex.en: Here are some tips for making better conversations.
ex.zh: 这里有一些让交谈更顺利的小建议。

ex.en: Train your brain for better sleep with 3 tips.
ex.zh: 用三个小窍门训练你的大脑，让你睡得更好。

ex.en: Listen carefully and answer the questions.
ex.zh: 仔细听并回答问题。

ex.en: Listening carefully, you will find a noisy world.
ex.zh: 仔细听，你会发现一个热闹的世界。

ex.en: When your friend talks about his hobby, show interest in it.
ex.zh: 当朋友谈论他的爱好时，要表现出兴趣。

ex.en: The little boy showed great interest in robots.
ex.zh: 那个小男孩对机器人表现出浓厚的兴趣。

ex.en: What do you think makes a good listener?
ex.zh: 你认为怎样才算一个好的倾听者？

ex.en: Are you a good listener?
ex.zh: 你是一个好的倾听者吗？

ex.en: If you want to make the other person happy, mention his or her strong points.
ex.zh: 如果你想让对方高兴，就提提他或她的长处。

ex.en: Some leaves always have five points on them.
ex.zh: 有些叶子总是有五个尖。

ex.en: If someone tells you their hobby and you can ask questions about it, they will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
ex.zh: 如果有人告诉你他们的爱好，而你能就此提问，他们肯定会很乐意继续聊下去。

ex.en: Different kinds of activities at break time will surely benefit us a lot.
ex.zh: 课间各种各样的活动一定会让我们受益匪浅。

ex.en: I'm going to continue with my boring work.
ex.zh: 我要继续做我那枯燥的工作了。

ex.en: At school, Emma and the other girls continued to tease her.
ex.zh: 在学校，埃玛和其他女孩继续取笑她。

ex.en: However, it is impolite to ask someone's age, weight, or other personal information.
ex.zh: 然而，询问别人的年龄、体重或其他个人信息是不礼貌的。

ex.en: No matter how impolite he was, the couple always politely said hello.
ex.zh: 无论他多么无礼，那对夫妇总是礼貌地打招呼。

ex.en: Why is it important to keep your personal details private?
ex.zh: 为什么保护个人信息隐私很重要？

ex.en: Maybe that's why I told her about my personal life.
ex.zh: 也许这就是我把私人生活告诉她的原因。

ex.en: Also, if you don't agree with others, don't argue with them.
ex.zh: 另外，如果你不同意别人的意见，不要和他们争吵。

ex.en: It's no use arguing with him. He never listens.
ex.zh: 和他争论没用，他从来不听。

ex.en: Just move on to another topic.
ex.zh: 换个话题就好。

ex.en: You can start with simple storybooks, and then move on to English magazines or newspapers.
ex.zh: 你可以从简单的故事书开始，然后再读英文杂志或报纸。

ex.en: Be honest and sincere.
ex.zh: 要诚实真诚。

ex.en: To them, any hug is offensive if it's not sincere.
ex.zh: 在他们看来，任何不真诚的拥抱都是冒犯。

ex.en: How much did you pay for the book?
ex.zh: 你买这本书花了多少钱？

ex.en: How much should a family of three pay for the camp?
ex.zh: 一家三口参加这个营地活动要付多少钱？

ex.en: Pay attention to your body language.
ex.zh: 注意你的肢体语言。

ex.en: If you are looking for some signs of the weather, pay attention to nature.
ex.zh: 如果你在寻找天气变化的迹象，就留意大自然吧。

ex.en: Pay attention to the intonation and pauses.
ex.zh: 注意语调和停顿。

ex.en: If you are looking for some signs of the weather, pay attention to nature.
ex.zh: 如果你在寻找天气变化的迹象，就留意大自然吧。

ex.en: Stand up straight, smile, and be yourself—you have a lot to offer.
ex.zh: 站直，微笑，做真实的自己——你有很多闪光点。

ex.en: Don't try to be like others. Just be yourself.
ex.zh: 不要试图模仿别人，做你自己就好。

ex.en: Stand up straight, smile, and be yourself—you have a lot to offer.
ex.zh: 站直，微笑，做真实的自己——你有很多闪光点。

ex.en: To celebrate the Year of the Snake, Shanghai offers lots of great events.
ex.zh: 为庆祝蛇年，上海举办了很多精彩的活动。

ex.en: Do you think the tips are reasonable?
ex.zh: 你认为这些建议合理吗？

ex.en: Sounds reasonable.
ex.zh: 听起来有道理。

ex.en: What do people use social media for?
ex.zh: 人们用社交媒体做什么？

ex.en: How can family and friends help you in social situations?
ex.zh: 在社交场合中，家人和朋友怎样能帮助你？

ex.en: The internet is an important medium for learning.
ex.zh: 互联网是一种重要的学习媒介。

ex.en: Cook over a medium heat.
ex.zh: 用中火烹饪。

ex.en: Social media allows people to connect with friends, share experiences, and stay on trend.
ex.zh: 社交媒体让人们能与朋友联系、分享经历、紧跟潮流。

ex.en: Once your video is ready, share it with friends and classmates or on social media.
ex.zh: 视频做好后，就分享给朋友和同学，或者发到社交媒体上。

ex.en: Friends should trust each other.
ex.zh: 朋友之间应该互相信任。

ex.en: I thought he was showing his trust to me by doing this.
ex.zh: 我认为他这样做是在向我表示信任。

ex.en: Keep the medicine away from children.
ex.zh: 把药放在孩子拿不到的地方。

ex.en: Keep away from the river. It's dangerous.
ex.zh: 远离那条河，很危险。

ex.en: Talking face to face can keep us away from misunderstandings.
ex.zh: 面对面交谈可以让我们避免误会。

ex.en: In the past, many foreigners held some misunderstandings and wrong opinions of China.
ex.zh: 过去，许多外国人对中国存在一些误解和错误看法。

ex.en: The event will take place at 9 a.m. on 10th January.
ex.zh: 活动将于1月10日上午9点举行。

ex.en: How will children get the books they enjoy in the event?
ex.zh: 在这次活动中，孩子们将怎样得到他们喜欢的书？

ex.en: The event will take place at 9 a.m. on 10th January.
ex.zh: 活动将于1月10日上午9点举行。

ex.en: Kid Inventors' Day takes place on January 17th every year.
ex.zh: 每年的1月17日是少年发明家日。

senses.zh: 价格为；使损失；使付出努力

ex.en: If you are able to attend the event, we will cover all your travel and hotel costs.
ex.zh: 如果你能参加这次活动，我们将承担你全部的交通和住宿费用。

ex.en: And of course it cost a lot of money.
ex.zh: 当然，这花了很多钱。

ex.en: The event is an excellent opportunity for students, parents, and teachers to hear new opinions and ideas.
ex.zh: 这次活动是学生、家长和老师听取新观点和新想法的绝佳机会。

ex.en: It's a great opportunity for children to improve their football skills.
ex.zh: 这是孩子们提高足球技术的好机会。

ex.en: Reading benefits us a lot.
ex.zh: 阅读让我们受益匪浅。

ex.en: Just three exercise snacks a day can benefit your physical health.
ex.zh: 每天只做三次“运动零食”就能有益身体健康。

ex.en: How can we benefit from each other's similarities and differences?
ex.zh: 我们怎样才能从彼此的相同和不同之处获益？

ex.en: Students can benefit from reading every day.
ex.zh: 学生们可以从每天阅读中受益。

ex.en: We are looking forward to your reply.
ex.zh: 我们期待您的回复。

ex.en: "Nobody needs me or loves me," replied the sad tree.
ex.zh: “没有人需要我，也没有人爱我。”伤心的树回答说。

ex.en: It would be a great honour to have you speak at our school.
ex.zh: 如果您能来我校演讲，我们将倍感荣幸。

ex.en: It's an honour to be chosen as the class monitor.
ex.zh: 被选为班长是一种荣誉。

ex.en: I sincerely hope you can come to my birthday party.
ex.zh: 我真诚地希望你能来参加我的生日聚会。

ex.en: Yours sincerely, Li Hua
ex.zh: 你真诚的，李华

ex.en: Decide whether each sentence is the opening or the closing for an invitation letter.
ex.zh: 判断每个句子是邀请信的开头还是结尾。

ex.en: In the opening match, Changzhou Team had a close game with Nantong Team.
ex.zh: 在揭幕战中，常州队和南通队打得难分难解。

ex.en: Decide whether each sentence is the opening or the closing for an invitation letter.
ex.zh: 判断每个句子是邀请信的开头还是结尾。

ex.en: The closing time changes throughout the year.
ex.zh: 闭馆时间全年会有变化。

ex.en: Notice the difference in stress and meaning of the same sentence.
ex.zh: 注意同一个句子在重音和意思上的不同。

ex.en: Which of the following sentences can be put in the blank?
ex.zh: 下列哪个句子可以放入空白处？

ex.en: Please write the date at the top of the letter.
ex.zh: 请在信的顶部写上日期。

ex.en: Once you've made sure, add the trip date to your calendars.
ex.zh: 确定之后，就把出行日期记到你的日历上。

ex.en: Can you use if-clauses to talk about possible future actions?
ex.zh: 你能用if从句谈论将来可能的行动吗？

ex.en: An if-clause can come at the beginning or the end of a sentence.
ex.zh: if从句可以放在句首，也可以放在句尾。
